caption_short: That cloud-like softness you've been dreaming of? It's real. The NAUTICA Signature Comforter in Pearl wraps you in aloe vera-infused luxury — soft, breathable, and effortlessly elegant. Your bedroom deserves this upgrade.
caption_extended:
There's something about sinking into a bed that feels like a cloud at the end of a long day. The NAUTICA Signature Comforter in Pearl brings that feeling home — crafted with aloe vera gel fiber filling and an ultra-soft micro fabric shell that actually gets softer with every wash.

The pearl tone adds a quiet sophistication to any bedroom, while the anti-microbial layer keeps things fresh season after season. Whether it's a cool winter night or a breezy AC evening, this all-weather comforter has you covered — literally.

Now at ₹4,199 (40% off). Because luxury should be attainable.
